features.text: THERAPEUTIC HAND RECOVERY: Designed to address mild to moderate contractures of the wrist, hand, and fingers through gentle stretching and positioning.
HEAT-MOLDABLE INSERT: Provides a custom contour to match each patient’s anatomy for optimal comfort and function.
STATIC/FLEX NEURO-DYNAMIC THERAPY: Delivers low-load prolonged stretch (LLPS) to lengthen soft tissue and reduce spasticity.
FLEXIBLE FINGER PLATFORM: Supports natural hand alignment with individual finger separators for balanced pressure distribution.
EASY-TO-USE COLOR-CODED STRAPS: Simplifies fitting and adjustments for patients and clinicians.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
